title: Text and Number Together
prompt: Print: Count: 7 — one print call, the number as a number.

tests.name: one print call with both
tests.code:
assert printed == ["Count: 7"], f"got {printed}"
assert code.count(",") >= 1, "pass 7 as a number argument"
tests.hint: print("Count:", 7) - print joins arguments with spaces.
